productsIntro.heading: Software made to solve real problems.
productsIntro.body: We build focused products around real workflows — making everyday business easier without adding unnecessary complexity.

zaiko.heading:
Know what you have.
Know where it went.
Know what it cost.
zaiko.body: Zaiko gives restaurants a clearer way to manage inventory, purchases, costs, and product activity — all from one place.
zaiko.theme1Desc: Know what you have and where it is.
zaiko.theme3Desc: Understand what your inventory is really costing.
zaiko.theme4Desc: See how inventory moves through your operation.

customSoftware.heading: When the right software doesn't exist, we build it.
customSoftware.body: Have an idea, a business problem, or a workflow that existing software can't solve? Venkoi designs and develops custom software for businesses, startups, and entrepreneurs — with a strong focus on mobile experiences and the technology behind them.
customSoftware.mobileDesc: Modern mobile experiences built around the people who actually use them — from customer-facing products to internal business tools.
customSoftware.webDesc: Dashboards, management tools, and responsive web applications designed around real business workflows.
customSoftware.backendDesc: APIs, business logic, and integrations that connect your applications, systems, and data.

local.heading: Great software starts with understanding the business behind it.
local.body: We're based in Tampa Bay and believe working closely with the people using the software leads to better products and better solutions.
local.southFloridaDesc: A growing part of the businesses and communities we serve.
local.beyondDesc: A good problem to solve doesn't have to be nearby.
local.prominentStatement: Talk directly to the people building your software.

philosophy.heading: Software should remove complexity, not create more of it.
philosophy.item1Desc: Powerful doesn't have to mean complicated.
philosophy.item2Desc: We start by understanding how people actually work.
philosophy.item3Desc: Businesses change. Good software should change with them.

aboutPreview.heading: We build software we believe should exist.
aboutPreview.p1: Venkoi is a Tampa Bay software company focused on creating practical digital products and building custom solutions when the right product doesn't exist yet.
aboutPreview.p2: We believe the best software starts with understanding a real problem, removing unnecessary complexity, and building something people actually want to use.
aboutPreview.p3: We're starting close to home while building products designed to grow far beyond it.

finalCta.heading: Let's build something useful.
finalCta.body: Whether you're interested in a Venkoi product or have an idea that needs to become software, we'd like to hear about it.

customSoftwarePage.heading: Your problem doesn't have to fit inside someone else's software.
customSoftwarePage.body: We design and build custom digital products around your idea, your users, and the way your business actually works.
customSoftwarePage.mobileSectionTitle: Mobile first when mobile is where the work happens.
customSoftwarePage.mobileSectionBody: From customer-facing products to internal tools, we design mobile experiences around the people, workflows, and environments where they're actually used.
customSoftwarePage.webBody: Responsive applications, dashboards, and management tools built around the workflows your business actually needs.
customSoftwarePage.backendBody: The APIs, business logic, and integrations that keep applications, systems, and data working together.
customSoftwarePage.ideaTitle: You don't need a finished specification.
customSoftwarePage.ideaBody: Bring us the idea, the problem, or the process that isn't working. We'll help turn it into a product that can actually be built.

aboutPage.heading: Software should make business easier.
aboutPage.body: Venkoi is a software company based in Tampa Bay, Florida, focused on building useful digital products and custom software around real problems.
aboutPage.productDirectionHeading: Products first. Solutions when you need them.
aboutPage.productDirectionBody: Our long-term focus is creating software products that can help many businesses. When an existing product isn't the right answer, we also work directly with companies and entrepreneurs to create one.
aboutPage.venkoiProductsDesc: Scalable products such as Zaiko designed for widespread operational needs.
aboutPage.customSoftwareDesc: Tailored solutions created for specific business problems and unique workflows.
aboutPage.localGlobalHeading: Close enough to understand. Built to go further.
aboutPage.localGlobalBody: Venkoi is starting in Tampa Bay, working close to the businesses and people using the software we create. That proximity helps us understand real workflows and real problems — while the products we build are designed to grow far beyond one market.

contactPage.heading: Let's start a conversation.
contactPage.body: Whether you have a project in mind, a question about our products, or just want to connect, we'd love to hear from you.
contactPage.locationBoxDesc: Based in Tampa Bay, Florida · Serving clients across South Florida & beyond.
contactPage.emailBoxDesc: Reach out directly for custom development inquiries or product demos.
